job.job_description:
Dear Candidate.

We are seeking an experienced Full Stack GenAI Engineer. This role blends modern front-end engineering (React) with backend and GenAI engineering (Python) to build enterprise-grade GenAI applications on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will develop user-centric AI experiences, integrate agentic workflows using Google ADK and MCP, and deliver secure, scalable solutions aligned to Risk and governance expectations.




Location: Noida (Work from Office)

Experience: 6+ years




Required Technical Skills:

Front End

React (advanced): component design, state management, performance optimization, accessibility, and API integration.
Strong UI engineering fundamentals: modular design, error handling, and responsive layouts.

Backend and Programming

Python (advanced): API development, data handling, async patterns (as needed), testing, packaging, and clean architecture. GenAI and Agentic Frameworks (Core)
Hands-on experience with Google ADK and MCP for agent or tool orchestration and connectors.
Working knowledge of LangChain and LangGraph (prompting, tools, orchestration concepts, stateful workflows).

Cloud

Google Cloud Platform (GCP): experience building and deploying applications in enterprise settings.
Familiarity with secure cloud patterns: IAM concepts, secrets management, networking basics, logging and monitoring.

Databases and Vector Stores (Any)

Experience with at least one database and a vector store, for example: pgvector, Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, Elastic or OpenSearch.
Understanding of embedding-based retrieval, indexing, and retrieval quality tuning.



Required Experience:

Must be proficient in ReactJS and Python.
Must have production experience with LangChain and Google ADK.
Must have at least 1 production-grade GenAI application built with these technologies.
Must have 6+ years of work experience.
